intro: Blackrock Blockade is an Alliance military task issued by Marshal Marris in Lakeshire. Confronting the encroaching Blackrock orcs east of Lake Everstill, the town guard aims to starve out the invaders and seize their weaponry.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You can't fight a war without weapons.
Though the Blackrock orcs have encroached upon these lands, their brazen efforts are not without certain vulnerabilities.
Head southeast below Stonewatch Keep, seek out their encampments, and target their weapons and supplies.
We'll see just how much of a threat they are without their tools of war.
